name: Oscar De La Torre
office: Santa Monica Community College District, Member of the Board of Trustees

items.text: Oscar De La Torre founded the Pico Youth & Family Center. He is a former Santa Monica city councilmember. He served on the Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District Board of Education from 2002 to 2020. His campaign says he would improve retention and graduation rates, create student and workforce housing, and start a workforce retraining initiative. On the board, he supported restorative justice and racial equity in student discipline.
